texto: When placed in the first syntactic position, these adverbs connectors require the immediate inversion of the subject and verb (the conjugated verb occupies position 2): **Danach rufe ich im Hotel an**.

Open the message with the starting point (**Zuerst packe ich meinen Koffer**), continue with the intermediate steps (**Dann fahre ich zum Bahnhof**, **Danach kaufe ich das Ticket**) and complete the action (**Schließlich komme ich am Ziel an**).

frases.de: Hast du alles für unseren Urlaub vorbereitet, Tim?
frases.es: ¿Has preparado todo para nuestro viaje, Tim?
frases.en: Have you prepared everything for our trip, Tim?

frases.de: Ja! Zuerst packe ich meinen Koffer.
frases.en: Yes! I'll pack my bag first.
And what do you do next?
analisis: What are you doing after that?

frases.de: Danach rufe ich im Hotel an und schließlich kaufe ich die Fahrkarten.
frases.es: Después llamo al hotel y finalmente compro los billetes.
frases.en: Then I call the hotel and finally buy the tickets.
analisis: danach rufe ich im Hotel an
After that I call the hotel

bloques.pregunta: What syntactic effect does it produce to place «danach» at the beginning of a main sentence?

opciones.texto: The conjugated verb goes in second position and the subject passes behind
opciones.explicacion: The adverbian connectors occupy position 1 and cause investment (Danach rufe ich an).

opciones.texto: The verb moves at the absolute end of the sentence
opciones.explicacion: Only subordinate conjunctions send the verb at the end.

opciones.texto: The subject should always be kept before the verb
opciones.explicacion: In German you can't say «Danach ich rufe an».

bloques.pregunta: What connector is usually used to close the last step of a sequence?

opciones.explicacion: «schließlich» finally means or finally concludes a series of steps.
«weil» introduces a cause («because»), not a chronological order.

bloques.frase: Zuerst frühstücke ich, ___ fahre ich zur Arbeit.

opciones.explicacion: «dann» introduces the following chronological step («then / after»).
«weil» expresses causality and moves the verb at the end.
After the «danach» connector in position 1, the conjugated verb goes in position 2 (rufe ich an).
It does not make the compulsory investment after the warning.

bloques.frase: Danach rufe ich im Hotel an.

opciones.explicacion: danach = after that; rufe an = call (on the phone).

opciones.texto: I called the hotel first to book.
The hotel will call me later.
opciones.explicacion: The subject of the call is «ich» (I).

bloques.frase: Zuerst lernen wir, und ___ gehen wir mit Freunden ins Kino.

opciones.explicacion: «aber» is an adversative conjunction («but»), not a temporary conclusion.

bloques.frase: Danach rufe ich im Hotel an
bloques.explicacion: danach in position 1 causes the verbo- subject investment.

intro: To structure a narrative, a mail or a sequence of instructions clearly, we use chronological order connectors: **zuerst** (first), **dann** (then), **danach** (after that) and **schließlich** (finally / finally).
